appearance_facts.fact: Bold title reads 'Falling Respiratory Infection Cases in Sentinel Sites from 2012 to 2023'. Subtitle below: 'Sentinel surveillance record shown in the dashboard summary'. This title wording conflicts with the plotted line trend.
A single purple line chart spans x-axis years 2012-2023. The line starts low near y≈1000 at 2012, rises overall to a peak near y≈3000 at 2022, then dips slightly at 2023.

From 2012 (~1000) the line climbs to ~1500 by 2014, dips to ~1200 at 2015, rises to ~1500 at 2017, jumps to ~2150 at 2018, plateaus ~2100 at 2019-2020, then climbs steeply to ~2850 at 2021, peaks ~3000 at 2022, and falls to ~2850 at 2023.
The dominant visual pattern is an upward/increasing trend across the decade, with a small decline only in the final year (2022→2023).
Y-axis labeled 'Respiratory infection cases' with ticks 0, 700, 1400, 2100, 2800. X-axis labeled 'Year' with ticks 2012 through 2023.
